annotations.text:
Direction: MG Network palette (navy #061F52, blue #0B74F6, cyan #12BCEB, teal #11D4B2) replaces the Vite-default indigo and Bootstrap-copied button colors.

What changed vs. today:
- Compact 64px app bar with the logo mark instead of a 360px centered logo + hero text
- Lecture title, session id and connection status live in the bar (no separate grey strips)
- One primary action (Start recording); exports grouped as a single button set
- Checkboxes become switches; Settings is an icon button
- Cards get a header row with a status hint and a real empty state
- Dark theme is navy-tinted, not flat #1a1a1a

Settings gains an Appearance section: System / Light / Dark, stored per browser.
